item: The launcher race test releases its stand-in lock in one rename (row 171)
summary: The takeover test's remade case failed on macOS with 4 workers: its cleanup killed the stand-in holder, then ran rm -rf on the lock in place, and the deferred child could start a takeover inside the lock while rm walked it, leaving a lock directory with no pid file, which nobody takes over. The cleanup now renames the lock away first, as the launcher releases one, then kills the holder and removes the copy. A timeout names what is left. Test-only.
